recommendedTextbook.title: Computer Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 3
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Bamiro, A. O. Nurudeen, M. O. Akande
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Spreadsheets: Electronic Ledger Modeling and Formulas
subtopics: Features of spreadsheet applications (Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets): Worksheets, cells, rows, columns
Data types in spreadsheets: Text, numbers, date/time, formulas
Basic arithmetic functions: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MAX, MIN, and relative vs absolute cell referencing
objectives: Enter numerical data into a spreadsheet grid with proper headers
Use the SUM and AVERAGE functions to calculate student test scores and grades
Construct a 2D column bar chart displaying termly broadsheet statistics

subtopics: Meaning and benefits of computer networks (resource sharing, centralized data, communication)
Classification by geographical scale: LAN (Local Area Network), MAN (Metropolitan), WAN (Wide Area Network)
Network physical topologies: Bus, star, ring, mesh, tree, and hybrid topologies
objectives: Differentiate a school local area network (LAN) from the global internet (WAN)
Draw and explain star topology using a central network switch
State advantages and failure risks of bus and ring network setups

topics.topic: The Internet, Web Browsers and Search Engines
subtopics: The World Wide Web (WWW) vs the Internet: URL structure, web pages, hyperlinks
Web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) and web search engines (Google, Bing)
Internet protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, email protocols (SMTP, POP3, IMAP)
objectives: Deconstruct the components of a complete URL (Protocol, domain, path)
Demonstrate effective information retrieval using boolean search operators (AND, OR, NOT)
Explain the security significance of the padlock icon and HTTPS encryption

subtopics: Malware threats: Viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, spyware, phishing attacks
Symptoms of virus infection: Slow system, corrupted files, unexpected popups, reboot loops
Preventive security: Antivirus software updates, firewalls, strong passwords, data backups
objectives: Distinguish computer viruses from worms and phishing scams
Outline 5 golden rules for creating secure digital passwords
Formulate cyber-ethics guidelines for responsible social media participation
